_about: Hunting screen text. Family-friendly: animals fall or run off; nothing graphic.
hunt.title: Hunting
hunt.status.meat: Meat shot: {meat} lb (you can carry {carry} lb)
hunt.status.shots: Powder and lead for {n} more shots
hunt.footer: Click on an animal to shoot.  Enter: back to the wagons.  Esc: pause.
hunt.footer.over: Click or press Enter to go back to the wagons.
hunt.start: {who} takes the gun and goes out on foot, and waits quietly for game.
hunt.appears_herd: Game comes into sight: {animal}, {n} of them.
hunt.appears_lion: A {animal}! It is watching {who} from the long grass.
hunt.lion_leaves: The {animal} thinks better of it and slinks away.
hunt.misfire: Click! The flint sparks but the powder does not catch.
hunt.kill: Bang! The {animal} falls. That is {n} lb of meat.
hunt.kill_predator: Bang! The {animal} falls. The herd will be safer tonight.
hunt.wounded: The {animal} is hit, but not down.
hunt.charges: The {animal} turns and comes straight at {who}! Load and fire!
hunt.charged: The {animal} reaches {who}. {who} is knocked down and hurt.
hunt.out_of_shot: There is no more powder and lead to load.
hunt.sundown: The sun is going down. Time to go back.
hunt.summary.all: All of it can be carried back to the wagons.
hunt.summary.too_much: Only {carry} lb can be carried back to the wagons. The rest is left for the jackals and vultures.
hunt.summary.none: {who} comes back to the wagons with nothing.
hunt.summary.go: Click or press Enter to go on
journal.hunt: {who} went hunting and brought back meat: {fresh} lb fresh and {dried} lb dried as biltong.
journal.hunt_empty: {who} went hunting and came back with nothing.
defend.title: Guarding the herd
defend.footer: Click on an animal to shoot.  Enter: go back to the fire.  Esc: pause.
defend.start: {who} takes the gun out to the herd. Somewhere in the dark there are {animal}s.
defend.appears: Eyes in the dark: a {animal} is creeping up on the herd.
defend.appears_pack: Eyes in the dark: {n} {animal}s, creeping up on the herd.
defend.took: A {animal} dashes in and carries off one of the {item}!
defend.dropped: The {animal} drops the one it took. One of the {item} is saved.
defend.wounded: The {animal} is hit and makes off into the dark.
defend.give_up: {who} goes back to the fire and leaves the herd to the {animal}s.
defend.quiet: The night goes quiet. The {animal}s have gone.
defend.dawn: Grey light in the east. The {animal}s slink off before the sun.
defend.summary.nothing: {who} kept watch all night, but never drove a {animal} off.
defend.summary.safe: Not a single beast was lost.
defend.summary.lost: Lost in the night: {n} of the {item}.
journal.defend: {who} guarded the herd against {animal}s through the night; {n} head of stock were lost.
journal.defend_safe: {who} guarded the herd against {animal}s through the night, and not a beast was lost.
travel.hunt_locked: Needs powder, lead and someone who can shoot
